name: Ilford HP5 Plus
notes: B&W single-layer path. H&D approx from Ilford HP5 Plus technical data sheet characteristic curves (ID-11 / Ilfotec DD-X pictorial development); straight-line gamma ≈ 0.62 (HP5+ is slightly softer / longer-toed than Tri-X in typical soup). logE = 0 at ISO speed point. spectral_crosstalk is 1×3 panchromatic weights from Ilford HP5+ spectral sensitivity (classic panchromatic, green-weighted). dir_coupler identity 1×1. RMS granularity ~14 (Ilford quotes diffuse RMS in this neighborhood for HP5+; slightly finer than Tri-X 17). Mild halation, green_fraction 0. Print paper grade ~2, gamma ≈ 2.05. Memory approximation of Ilford published curves. | tuned against 5 real San Marcos Filmlab HP5 JPEG scans 2026-07-10
